snowhunter
설산 창 돌진병

Catalogue TOP SECOND: young man black topknot, blue headband/crown and long blue ribbons, blue winter tunic and white fur collar/cuffs, leather belts, dark trousers and boots. ONE straight dark spear with silver leaf point and blue tassel. Two hands at separated positions on the SAME shaft.

Spear dash-thrust at chest level: early draw-back beside hip, maximum load bends rear elbow and braces feet; contact forward lunge with rear arm extending and front hand guiding continuous straight shaft; followthrough extension then retract, return guard. No overhead swing, no second handle.
snowweaver
설산 빙술사

Ordinary iceweaver based on catalogue BOTTOM FIRST silhouette: young woman with black hair in compact tied bun and simple blue ribbon (no jeweled boss crown), plain pale-blue winter robe, white fur collar/cuffs, dark boots. LEFT hand holds ONE small solid pale-blue icy orb (not luminous); RIGHT hand empty for casting. Simpler costume than boss Xuelan, no large flowing ornate cloak.

Cold-field casting: keep orb attached to LEFT palm near flank throughout; empty RIGHT palm gathers close to chest, extends forward toward target at contact, softly follows then withdraws. Natural fingers, linked shoulder elbow wrist, torso turns as one. No projectile or glowing thread drawn in sheet, game renders spell separately.
snowbowman
설산 궁수

Catalogue TOP THIRD: young female hunter, dark braided hair, burgundy winter cap with wide white fur band, burgundy fur-trimmed coat, leather straps, brown trousers/boots, compact quiver on back. ONE compact curved wooden BOW with ONE taut string; anatomical LEFT hand grips bow centre, RIGHT hand draws string to cheek.

Archery: early lift bow, maximum draw RIGHT hand to cheek and bend right elbow behind, LEFT arm points toward target; contact release RIGHT fingers, no arrow (game draws it), string relaxes, followthrough right hand near jaw then lower bow and reach to quiver, return ready. Bow always in left hand, never reverse hands or turn bow into crossbow. Front/back attacks foreshortened toward bottom/top.

Boss long spear thrust: draw back beside hip with connected elbows, maximum crouched brace and torso coil, contact advance front foot with chest-level straight extension toward target, shoulders/pelvis aligned; followthrough then rear elbow draws spear back. LEFT hand supports ONE small solid pale-blue ice orb of fixed size; RIGHT hand empty casting hand. Orb has crystalline detail but NO luminous aura or cast light.

Ice-silk casting: orb stays in anatomical LEFT palm beside waist, RIGHT fingers gather close to chest and then extend toward target at contact, shoulders and torso turn coherently with planted foot, followthrough and withdraw. Keep exactly two hands, no opaque threads crossing torso, no light halo or floating second orb. Game draws ice attacks separately.

Heavy palm strike: anatomical RIGHT hand draws at ribs with bent elbow, LEFT fist guards chest; hips and shoulders rotate together, contact RIGHT palm extends toward target with natural wrist, front knee bends and rear foot remains grounded, followthrough slight lean then retract right elbow and reset. hanxue
빙궁주 한설

Catalogue BOTTOM THIRD: regal young woman with long SILVER hair, ornate ice crystal blue crown and dangling ornaments, layered silver/ice-blue robes with white fur mantle, dark shoes. ONE pale-blue crystalline folding FAN in RIGHT hand, fingers grip root/rivet firmly; LEFT hand empty for balance.

Fan sweep-cast: right fan held raised outside rear shoulder, torso coils gently, contact sweep DOWN-FORWARD across target with fan root attached to right hand, followthrough outward chest/waist height then withdraw outside torso and return ready. Fully connected arm joints, stable pelvis and spine. Fan retains same physical size and ribs, not magic sword, no aura or emission; game draws ice effects separately.
